unit_of_analysis: image patch (matched across methods by index)
multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni within each metric across all (family, level, seed, baseline) comparisons
clustering: Patches are nested within source images and are not independent. Where cluster labels are available the analysis additionally reports (a) a cluster bootstrap CI resampling whole source images, and (b) a Wilcoxon test on per-source-image mean differences. The cluster-level test is deliberately low-powered: it reports the evidence the sampling design supports.

psnr_definitions.psnr: whole-patch MSE (definition used by the sweep harness and all manuscript tables)
psnr_definitions.psnr_masked: MSE restricted to corrupted pixels only
